page.content:
Gansu passage between the Tibetan plateau and the Gobi.

How Hexi Corridor connects

  • Location: Dunhuang — Dunhuang sits at the west end of the Hexi Corridor.
  • Location: Overland Silk Road — The Hexi Corridor is the eastern bottleneck of the overland road.

What is Hexi Corridor?

The Hexi Corridor is the bottleneck from the Chinese interior toward Dunhuang. Whoever held its oasis towns could tax or close the eastern overland trade.

Key threads lead to Dunhuang and Overland Silk Road.
